title: Matter
description: A matter as this API publishes it.

id.title: Id
id.description: Public identifier, `mat_` followed by 32 hex characters. This is the value that goes in every matter-nested path.

clientId.title: Clientid
clientId.description: `cli_` identifier of the client this matter belongs to, if one was set.

instructions.title: Instructions
instructions.description: Standing instructions the customer wants applied to AI work on this matter. Carried into drafting and review prompts.

status.title: Status
status.description: Lifecycle status. Usually `open`, `pending` or `closed`, but published as a plain string because production holds values no UI offers. Do not branch on it without a fallback.

practiceArea.title: Practicearea
practiceArea.description: Practice area, for example `employment` or `real_estate`. Free text.

matterType.title: Mattertype
matterType.description: Customer's own sub-classification of the matter. Free text.

responsibleAttorneyName.title: Responsibleattorneyname
responsibleAttorneyName.description: Name of the attorney responsible for the matter. The underlying user id is deliberately not published.

closeDate.title: Closedate
closeDate.description: Date the matter closed (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Absent while it is open.

billingType.title: Billingtype
billingType.description: Billing arrangement, normally one of `hourly`, `flat_fee`, `contingency` or `pro_bono`. Published as a plain string.

billingRate.title: Billingrate
billingRate.description: Billing rate in `billingCurrency`. Rendered as a JSON STRING, not a number, so the value stays exact.

billingCurrency.title: Billingcurrency
billingCurrency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for `billingRate`, for example `USD`.

country.title: Country
country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, for example `US`. Unlike a client's `country`, this is a validated code.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Arbitrary JSON the customer stores against the matter. Vaquill never reads it.

isDefault.title: Isdefault
isDefault.description: True for the one matter minted at signup that unfiled work lands in. Read-only: exactly one exists per organization and this API cannot create or move it.

updatedAt.title: Updatedat
updatedAt.description: When the matter was last modified (RFC 3339).
